content: Taunoya gureipi sipinama nopone ta noyana wainasidima
Be Yesu na giuma ya kaiwatani be ya riuna, “Mara na waiguyauma inam umanama: Raḡan tenaḡa sipi taupakinama raḡanboiboi kupinaḡa ya naḡo be banaga ya kokonedina, da na sipie sibo a noyana.
Be taudi matabudi ai anina tenaḡa da taudi matabudi adi noyama damone ravie taudi tenatenaḡaḡa Denari tenaḡaḡa ei maesidina. Naumeki be ya riu poredina na sipie.
“Be raḡanboiboi suara ya tavatavana nama, tauna ya dobi ya munaḡa be banaga ḡesaudima anikune gabune a midimidi yabayababana ya banavidina.
Dabudine ya riuedina, ‘Taumi ko naḡo be yau sipie ko noyana, be taugu tokare taumi yai maesimina.’
Naumeki da taudi a naḡona na sipie noya aubainama. “Naumeki da suaratopu be tauḡominama ya dobi ya munaḡana, be kauinama teneḡinama ya voiena. Be ravie kauinama teneḡinama ya voiena.

“Be suara ya yovoyovona raḡanine, tauna ya dobi ya munaḡa be yaḡoro banaga a midimidi yabayababana ya banavidina. Dabudine ya riuedina, ‘Taumi suara daudau aba uma dabudi ko midi yabayababa be ko voivoie?’
Be taudi a riuna, ‘Tauma nam aitau i kokonemaina da aba sibo kè voie.’ Be tauna ya riuedina, ‘Naumeki, taumi mate ko naḡo yau sipie ko noyana.’

“Be ravi ḡomae noya ya kovikovina, sipi taupakinama taunoya adi badama ya yokoe be ya riuena, ‘Taunoya matabudi kwa rawateḡeidi be adi maesama kwa utedina. Aitauḡa muriḡa a tava be noya awai karena, taudi ḡarodie waimaia kwai karena naumeki da banaga noya awai kare dokena ḡarodie kwa tavana.’
Naumeki da taudi aitau da suara ya yovoyovona raḡanine noya aubainama a tavatavana, taudi tenatenaḡaḡa a verau be Denari tenatenaḡaḡa a ragaudina.
Be aitauḡa noya aubainama a tavatava dokana, taudi awai noḡotana kabe mane dosinama ta paḡo. Be ibewa da taudi matabudi Denari tenaḡaḡa a ragaudina.
Taudi mane a paḡopaḡona raḡanine, sipi taupakinama ḡarone momodu ai kare be a riuna,
‘Tauma noya dosinama kè voie be suara debamaie ya kara kuruvana. Be inam banegidima taudi muriḡa ḡoma a tava be nam noya dosinama ti voiena. Be tam maesa teneḡinama kuya utedina.’
“Be sipi taupakinama ya paribeedi be ya riuna, ‘Badam, taugu nam gewagewa ḡarome e voiena, baninama noḡone tam kuyai aninana da Denari tenaḡa sibo è utemina noya murine.
Vutuna aubainama am manema kwa paḡo be kwa naḡona. Be taugu yà ḡoeḡoena da banaga muriḡa è kokokokonedina maesa teneḡinama yà utedina maika tam.
Taugu yau pairuma aubainama tam kuya unura, bo? Uma inam taugu yau manema, vutuna aubainama taugu yà ḡoeḡoena nama banaga yà utena.’
“Naumeki da aitau da tawai murina, taudi tokare ta dokana, be aitau da ta dokadokana, taudi tokare tai murina.”
Yesu nema e guri bakona raḡan aniwai rabuiteḡanama ya giu munaḡena
Yesu na tauwai muriwatanama mate Jerusalemma a naḡonaḡona raḡanine, kadae na tauwai muriwatanama ya riuedi da ḡavoe taudiḡa be ya riuedina,

“Tauda tà naḡonaḡona Jerusalemma be dabudine Banaga Natunama tokare banaga ta boru dobiḡena pirisi adi babadama be tarawatu tauwai katakataidima nimedie. Be taudi adi ogama a taraḡina da tauna tokare tai gurina.

Be taudi tokare Banaga Natunama ta paḡo be banaga aitauḡa nam Jius taudi nimedie ta boru nawe da taudi tai diboḡi, ta kwapu be korosie ta tuparatuna. Be raḡan wairabuiteḡane tauna e midisuḡu munaḡana.”
Jeims be Jon tinedima na waibaḡama
Dabudine Sebedi natunatunama tinedima mate Yesu ḡarone a tava be tinedima tuapikane ya raupari be na ḡoanama Yesu yai baḡana.

Be Yesu ya riuna, “Tam am ḡoanama aba?” Dabudine waivi ya riuna, “Kwai anina da am waiguyauma nopone yau sedama uma rabui, be tenaḡa sibo kasaumma yauwane ya miana, be tenaḡa sibo senimma yauwane ya miana.”
Be Yesu ya riuena, “Tam nam ku kataiena aba kwawai baḡena. Taumi teneteneḡina da taugu ḡoraḡoranama yà tegona nama tokare ko tego, bo?” Dabudine seda a riuna, “Ee, tokare ka tegona teneteneḡinama.”

Be Yesu ya riuedina, “Taumi riukaua tokare yau redue ko tegona, be kasaugue be senigue mieninama inam nam taugu amawai badena. Inam gabudima Tamaguma ya vokaukauedina, taudi banaga vinevinedima aubaidima.”
Tauwai muriwatana ḡesaudima matabudi 10-nama a vaivaiena raḡanine, taudi nuedima yai medina adi banagama rabui ḡarodie.

Vutuna aubainama Yesu taudi matabudi ya rawateḡeidi be ya riuedina, “Taumi koya kataiena da eteni babadidima tawai badabadana. Be babadidima ai rewapana vavasaḡana aubainama, taudi eteni tawai badedina.
Uma kauinama taumi ḡaromie nam nama e tubuḡa! Be deḡoda aitau tenaḡa nopomie moraba e ḡoena, naumeki da tauna e kaue da matabumi ami taunoyama e tubuḡana.
Be aitau saḡa gurata e ḡoena, naumeki da ei taunoyana ḡaromie.
Maika Banaga Natunama ya yovona, nam banaga tauna aubainama ti noyana, ibewa da tauna banaga aubaidima ya noyana, be na yawasanama yai utaena, da banaga toitoi e kuvesidina.”
Yesu tautauḡoma matapotepotedima rabui yai yawasanidina
Yesu na tauwai muriwatanama mate Jeriko a gosegosena raḡanine, patara dosinama tauna ai muriwatanena.

Dabudine tautauḡoma rabui matapotepotedima keda diane a miamiana. Be raḡanine ta vaiena be Yesu inam kedanaḡa ya naḡonaḡona, naumeki da taudi bonedima dosine a riuna, “Bada, guyau Deivid natunama, kwa raunuatoiemai!”
Be dabudine patara taudi a riutuaḡaiedina da sibo ai nuatuḡuna. Be taudi yaḡoro a riu guratana, “Bada, guyau Deivid natunama, kwa raunuatoiemai!”
Dabudine Yesu ya midi kwasa, be yai taraviredina, “Aba ko ḡoeḡoena yà voie?”
Be taudi a paribee be a riuna, “Bada, tauma ka ḡoeḡoena kai kitana.”
Be Yesu ya raunuatoiedi be matedima ya taukonidina. Be dabudine yai raḡantenaḡe da taudi ai kita be tauna ai muriwatanena.
